summary: Seven XP boxes (.110 .123 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) were proven together on shogo-server :27888. Proof per box: the roster names each one, packets are steady, and a fresh frame shows the level. .124 BLOCKED (D3D on vcr-kmd). .186 and .243 NA. kill closed client.exe gracefully on all seven, and PROCLIST then showed no client.exe or shogo.exe.
